title: ChroPack - Protein A
author: Alexandra Ehl
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.72mhqc6
materials: Do you want to purify antibodies or sanitize your column? Please choose below.

steps.title: Connect and initial water wash
steps.instruction: Connect the Protein A column to the FPLC system, set the flow rate to 1 bed volume per minute, and wash the dry column with 5 bed volumes of deionized water (the bed volume is indicated on the column). A dry column can be connected directly; air will be expelled through the bottom outlet.

steps.title: Equilibrate column with wash buffer
steps.instruction: Equilibrate the column by passing 5 to 10 bed volumes of wash buffer through it.

steps.title: Prepare and load sample
steps.instruction: Adjust the sample to pH 7.5–8.5 and 150–300 mM NaCl. Optionally add 1/11 volume of 0.5 M Tris, 2 M NaCl (pH 8.0). If yield is low, raise the pH by adding phosphate buffer. Remove particulates by centrifugation or 0.45 µm filtration. Load the clarified sample onto the column. For slow or weak‑binding antibodies, collect the flow‑through and re‑apply it.

steps.title: Wash column post‑binding
steps.instruction: Wash the column with 10 to 20 bed volumes of wash buffer, retaining the flow‑through and wash fractions for later analysis (e.g., SDS‑PAGE). If unspecific hydrophobic or ionic interactions are observed, include up to 1 % Tween‑20 and/or up to 0.5 M NaCl in the wash buffer.

steps.title: Elute bound protein
steps.instruction: Elute the bound antibody with 10 bed volumes of elution buffer and collect fractions of 0.5 to 1 bed volume each.

steps.title: Neutralize eluate
steps.instruction: Add neutralization solution (1 M Tris‑HCl, pH 8.5) to the eluate at a ratio of 100 µL neutralization solution per 900 µL eluate.

steps.title: Final column washes and storage
steps.instruction: Wash the column successively with 5 bed volumes of elution buffer, then 5 bed volumes of wash buffer, then 5 bed volumes of water. Follow with a wash of 5 bed volumes of either 20 % ethanol or wash buffer containing 0.05 % (w/v) sodium azide. Close the top lid, then the bottom stopper, and store the column at room temperature or at 4 – 8 °C.

steps.title: Flush column before reuse
steps.instruction: Reconnect the column to the FPLC system and flush sequentially with 5 bed volumes of water, 5 bed volumes of elution buffer, and 5 bed volumes of wash buffer (without urea), maintaining a flow rate of 1 bed volume per minute.

steps.title: Sanitization flush and incubation
steps.instruction: Flush the column with 5 bed volumes of sanitization solution, stop the pump, and let the column sit for 1 hour.

steps.title: Final wash, disconnect and store
steps.instruction: Flush with 5 bed volumes of PBS wash buffer containing 0.05 % (w/v) sodium azide, disconnect the column, close it, and store at 4 °C or at room temperature. Wait at least 12 hours before the next purification.
